user_sees: An answer with 'Answer written by AI from our help pages.' and 'Did this solve it?', or 'Thanks! We read every message.'

steps.action: Tap the button, tap 'Speak' and talk in Hindi

must_not: The microphone used before Speak is tapped

must_not: The message sent to the gym server instead of MettleUp

steps.action: Turn the internet off and tap 'Send'
user_sees: "Couldn't send. Check your internet and try again. Your message is still here."
must_not: A spinner with no end (15 s limit, 25 s for help)

The member's name or mobile number sent unless typed
Anything sent that the privacy notice does not name (the phone's push address and gym key are sent: finding 02)
